title: studio(flow inspector): object inputs suggest objects the app does not have — placeholders contract, contracts, crm_account, showcase_task, and the view inspector’s e.g. crm_lead
body:
**Filing gate ①: a product defect, class (a), misleading copy at a public entry.** Reach: Studio → Automations → open a flow, then select a record node (get / create / update / delete record), a screen or a time-relative trigger. Its *Object* input suggests an object the running app does not have. Measured live by the objectui#11783 dev on app-showcase (objectstack `bafb58bb`): the rendered `placeholder` attribute was `crm_lead` on the trigger (removed by PR objectui#11840). The other inputs read the same `field.placeholder`, and the live object list has no `contract`, `contracts` or `crm_account` (control: `showcase_account` is present).

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage, grade and route. ⛔ Not a claim. Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat 1 (`session_01DrKzdPdyLLBW3qpZ4vtk7z`) from the objectui#11783 dev report (`6049330932`, out-of-scope finding 1).

## What happens

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-node-config.ts`, on `main` `87f7b6c`, gives object inputs placeholders that name example objects of other apps:

| config field | line | placeholder |
|:--|:--|:--|
| get / create / update / delete record `objectName` | `:703`, `:708`, `:713`, `:717` | `contract` |
| legacy action `objectName` | `:1191` | `contract` |
| time-relative `object` | `:485` | `contracts` |
| screen `objectName` | `:821` | `crm_account` |
| map `itemObject` | `:699` | `showcase_task` (exists only in the showcase) |

The view inspector does the same through a locale row:
- `engine.inspector.view.objectPlaceholder`, `i18n.ts:571` (`e.g. crm_lead`) and `:3657` (`例如：crm_lead`);
- rendered by `ViewVariantInspector.tsx:443`.

An author reads a placeholder as a suggestion. One that names an object the app lacks reads as a hint to type a name that will not resolve.

## Done when

- No object-name input in Studio offers, as its placeholder, an object name that is not known to exist in the app being edited. That covers the flow config fields above and the view inspector row.
- Pins:
  - each listed field renders no hard-coded foreign object name;
  - control: inputs whose placeholder is not an object name keep theirs.

Same class as objectui#11783's `crm_lead`, which that card removed. The claimant picks the shape: drop the placeholders, or derive one from the package's own objects. A dropped locale row also leaves the parity checks.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *flow inspector object placeholder names an object the app does not have (contract, crm_account, crm_lead)*: 0 hits.
- Positive control in the same run: *renaming a flow node leaves its edges naming the old id* returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11827: yes.
